_about: Recorded from the real server by tests/P/client-fixtures.mjs (stream P-client, W9). Do not edit by hand.

usedProspector.name: Bram Delver
says: See the boulders with green in them, out past the gate? That is copper, and it is yours for the price of three good swings.

offers.name: Three Good Swings
offers.text: New boots, clean hands. You want work that pays? That pick I just gave you is yours. Walk out of the gate and look for boulders with green lumps sticking out: copper. Three swings each. Hit when the marker crosses the bright spot, not before, not after.
offers.done: That is ore, that is. A clean strike sometimes shakes a stone loose too: sell those dear. The boulders fill again for you in a few minutes, and nobody else can empty yours.

steps.where: the ore boulders by the road just outside Torborhold's gate

steps.text: Show Bram what you dug out
steps.where: Bram Delver, just inside Torborhold's main gate

reward.text: The Prospector's Pick is yours to keep, with a crate from the last fellow who never came back for it.

offers.name: Mine 8 pieces of ore
offers.text: Walk the road, hit what glints. Eight pieces of any ore and you have earned your supper.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.desc: Broken out of a boulder. A smith smelts it into bronze, with tin.

offers.name: Mine 4 Tin Ore
offers.text: Copper without tin is a doorstop. Four of tin, the grey boulders.

offers.name: Mine 6 Copper Ore
offers.text: The forge eats copper faster than I can swing. Six lumps of ore, any boulder with green in it.

offers.name: Smelt 3 Bronze Bars
offers.text: Use my fire. Three bronze bars on the rack and I will pay you for the sweat.
